fixture_reasons.test_p1_04_unrelated_change_does_not_reo: Unescaped goal/candidate/evidence_fp atoms are unknown BOARD fields. Preserve the old per-item fingerprint and the independent FUN_2 selection oracle; add canonical priority and DONE verification.
fixture_reasons.test_case04_repeat_same_command_no_dupli: Unescaped goal/candidate atoms make BOARD_INVALID before the active-work gate. Escape description separators, use [/] for DOING, add priority and verification.
fixture_reasons.test_case06_previous_ticket_completed_su: Candidate atom follows a legacy goal tag without the required pipe boundary. Use an exact description identity; retain conservative DONE suppression without a newer fingerprint and the proc_102 successor oracle.
fixture_reasons.test_case11_all_candidates_blocked: Unescaped candidate atom is an unknown field. Use escaped goal/candidate identity, priority, explicit external blocker and verification; keep blocked/no-admissible outcome, never satisfaction.
fixture_reasons.test_case16_crash_after_ticket_admission: Unescaped candidate atom prevents parsing the persisted TODO row. Use escaped exact identity, priority and verification; keep TODO_AVAILABLE rather than admitting another ticket.
fixture_reasons.test_case17_crash_after_ticket_closure_e: Unescaped candidate atom prevents parsing DONE. Use escaped exact identity, priority and prior verification; retain conservative DONE suppression and the independent proc_102 oracle.
fixture_reasons.test_case21_completed_ticket_invalid_no_: Title-only matching is prohibited. Supply explicit goal/candidate identity and a same-generation fingerprint; keep DONE unchanged, permit new evidence, reject title-only, prefix and foreign-goal false duplicates.
fixture_reasons.test_case24_one_task_blocked_independent: Unescaped candidate atom makes the whole board invalid. Use escaped exact identity, priority and external blocker/verification; keep proc_102 independent admission.
